router.get('/commands/:commandKey/status', validateParams(absenceCommandKeyParamSchema), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const status = await getAbsenceCommandStatus(
      req.params.commandKey as string,
      req.user!.employeeId,
    );
    res.json(status);
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});
